event.title: Visit Greece | Georgia Southern Alumni and Friends Travel Program
event.description:
Join Georgia Southern Alumni and Friends in Greece October 14 - 24, 2026!

 

In Greece, discover a place where age-old legends and monuments intertwine with warm sunshine and island-style living. From to the ruins of Athens to the bright rooftops of Mykonos and Santorini – embrace the country at its best.

 

All trips are open to all who would like to attend and are not limited to alumni. Children 5 and up are able to attend.

 

 

********************************

 

Trip Highlights include: 

 

  • Acropolis of Athens & The Parthenon
  • Taverna Dinner Show
  • Mykonos Old Town
  • Santorini Island
  • Oia Village
  • Ancient Akrotiri
  • Wine Tasting

 

********************************

 

Trip Pricing includes: 

 

  • Round Trip Air from Santorini Thira Is.

  • Round Trip Air from Savannah/Hilton Head

  • Air Taxes and Fees/Surcharges

  • Hotel Transfers

 

********************************

 

Trip Costs:
 

Single Traveler (One person in a room)

  • $7,199- Price per person

Double Traveler (Two people in a room)

  • $5,999- Price per person

Triple Traveler (Three people in a room)

  • $5,899 - Price per person

 

********************************

 

Save Your Spot & Learn More

Discover more about this amazing trip at:
GeorgiaSouthern.edu/alumni/Greece

Ready to travel? 
Click Here to Make your Trip Deposit of only $698 per person today!

event.title: The Merry Widow: A Comic Operetta by Franz Lehar
event.description:
Join Georgia Southern Opera and the Performing Arts Center for Franz Lehár’s The Merry Widow, one of the world’s most beloved and recognizable operettas. This timeless classic has enchanted audiences for more than a century with its unforgettable melodies, sparkling humor, and romantic intrigue.

Recommended for All Ages.

If you or someone in your party is in need of ADA assistance regarding seating, an interpreter, or other concerns, please contact us at (912) 478-7916 or pac@georgiasouthern.edu

event.title: New Organization Chartering Workshop | OSA
event.description:
Interested in chartering a new student organization on campus? Have two (2) chartering members attend our virtual New Organization Chartering Workshop to learn about the new student organization chartering process. 

Note: One of these officers must be the President or Primary Student Leader.
New student organization applications will be available for the 2026 Fall semester from September 1; 2026 - December 4; 2026. 

 

For more information on the chartering process; please view the Office of Student Activities website. https://students.georgiasouthern.edu/student-activities/start/.

 

Learn more at http://georgiasouthern.presence.io/event/new-organization-chartering-workshop-osa-38

event.title: Sometimes the Rain, Sometimes the Sea
event.description:
Sometimes the Rain, Sometimes the Sea

By Julia Izumi

The Little Mermaid is Hans Christian Andersen's most beloved and well-known fairy tale, which is why it's not the story our friend, Dolan, is going to tell you today. No, he's going to tell you the story about a Little Rain Cloud who falls in love with a human. They are not the same story at all, he swears. Join us in this delightful fairy tale for grown ups who sometimes need to remember it is not who you love but how you love.

 

Performances at 7:30 pm / Sunday Matinee at 2pm

Recommended for All Ages.

If you or someone in your party is in need of ADA assistance regarding seating, an interpreter, or other concerns, please contact us at (912) 478-7916 or pac@georgiasouthern.edu
